summary: Globus Maritime Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026 disclosing the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held the same day in Glyfada, Greece. Shareholders elected Athanasios Feidakis and Ioannis Kazantzidis as Class I directors to serve until the 2029 annual meeting and ratified Ernst & Young (Hellas) as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation on a deal was disclosed; this is a routine meeting-results notice, not a management-change event, since the named directors were elected in the ordinary course.
